messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 8):
"""
(d) In case of modification, where Changes proposed to the product impact Benefit Structure, Terms and Conditions and the Pricing, complete application shall be filed. 3. GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS (a) If an insurer wishes to offer Add-ons along with a basic health insurance product, the Company must furnish the information in respect of the respective Add-ons separately using this form for each proposed Add-on. Also the financial projections along with sensitivity analysis for each add-on benefit need to be furnished. (b) Where already cleared Add-on/s is/are proposed to be offered along with the new product now filed, Insurers shall necessarily furnish the financial projections / Sensitivity Analysis for each of the Addon separately. Note: If an insurer offers an existing Add-on A along with product X, product Y or product Z (e.g.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What must an insurer do if it wants to add a new add‑on to an existing basic health insurance product?","answer":"The insurer must submit a separate application for each proposed add‑on using the specified form and provide financial projections and sensitivity analysis for each add‑on.","facts":["If an insurer wishes to offer Add-ons along with a basic health insurance product, the Company must furnish the information in respect of the respective Add-ons separately using this form for each proposed Add-on.","Also the financial projections along with sensitivity analysis for each add-on benefit need to be furnished."]},{"question":"If an insurer has already cleared add‑ons and wants to offer them with a new product, what additional information is required?","answer":"The insurer must furnish financial projections and sensitivity analysis for each add‑on separately.","facts":["Where already cleared Add-on/s is/are proposed to be offered along with the new product now filed, Insurers shall necessarily furnish the financial projections / Sensitivity Analysis for each of the Addon separately."]}]}
